steps.title: Home
steps.note: Mike is Steady. Income swings, spending stays inside the band.

steps.title: Big client pays
steps.note: A big client payment lands. The feast check runs.
steps.message: Stabl: Good stretch. Tomorrow we will move $650.00 from Checking 4321 to your vault. Your bills stay covered. Reply STOP to skip it.

steps.title: One day later
steps.note: The buffer settles. The receipt shows both balances.
steps.message: Stabl: Moved $650.00 to your vault. Vault $1,930.00. Checking $2,105.33.

steps.title: Slow week
steps.note: No income and a $620.00 car repair. The fast check sends money back right away. No question asked.
steps.message: Stabl: Slow week, so we sent $410.00 from your vault to Checking 4321. It is there now. Vault $1,520.00.

steps.title: Emergency
steps.note: EMERGENCY typed in Telegram. The code shows in the app, never back in Telegram.
steps.message: Stabl: Emergency unlock requested. Your code is 482913 and it expires in 10 minutes. You have 1 emergency unlock left this quarter.

steps.title: Unlocked the same day
steps.note: Code and $150.00 entered. The money is in checking now.
steps.message: Stabl: Emergency unlock done. We sent $150.00 from your vault to Checking 4321. It is there now. Vault $1,370.00.

steps.title: The thread
steps.note: The messages tell the whole story with no screen explained.
